title: 2D Versus 3D Radical Laparoscopic Hysterectomy for Endometrial Cancer: a Prospective Randomized Trial
brief_summary: This prospective randomized pilot study is aimed to verify if the operative time of a total laparoscopical hysterectomy (TLH) with pelvic lymphadenectomy for endometrial cancer FIGO stage IB-II could be reduced using 3D laparoscopy versus standard laparoscopy
raw_criteria:
Inclusion/Exclusion Criteria:

* Age ≤ 75 years
* Patient's informed consent
* American Society of Anesthesiologists: \< class III or IV
* No actual pregnancies or P.I.D.
* No previous major abdominal surgical procedures
* Endometrial cancer FIGO stages IB-II
* Endometrioid histotype
* No previous radiotherapy on pelvic fields
* No uterine size larger than conform 10 weeks gestation
